resources.string: AthleteIQ reads resting heart rate, heart rate variability (HRV) when your device records it, sleep, workout duration, and steps from Health Connect to calculate training load, recovery trends, and injury-risk scores. We only read these metrics — we do not write data back to Health Connect. Most Android watches do not record HRV; that field is left blank rather than invented. Your coach sees wearable metrics only if you enable wearable sharing in Profile → Data sharing.
Resting heart rate helps AthleteIQ track recovery alongside your logged training sessions.
Heart rate variability (HRV) improves recovery scoring when your watch or phone records it in Health Connect.
Sleep duration is used with your training logs to estimate fatigue and recovery trends.
Step count from Health Connect is stored with your wearable snapshot. It is not turned into a fake training-load number.
AthleteIQ sends alerts when your coach approves a plan, when risk spikes, or when a wearable sync fails so you can reconnect your device.
